pages.title: Natural Water Only
pages.text: You can only fish in $(bold)large, open-air natural waters$(): rivers, oceans, beaches, or big lakes with at least 64 connected water blocks.$(br2)Small ponds and water with a roof over it yield nothing; dig a big enough open-air pond and it counts as fishable water.$(br2)This restriction can be turned off in the config.

pages.title: Before the Bite
pages.text: There must be a $(bold)living fish$() near your bobber for a bite to happen. With no fish around, that cast $(bold)never gets a bite at all$() - once you do get a bite, you always get something.$(br2)On a fish bite, the real fish is pulled to your feet and you have to kill it for the drops; $(bold)junk and treasure$() need no nearby fish and can still be caught (lily pads, leather boots, bones; or name tags, saddles, books, nautilus shells).$(br2)Luck and open water still affect your haul.

pages.title: Feeding Fish
pages.text: Dropping $(bold)almost anything edible$() into natural water works as fish bait: seeds, crops and ordinary food all count, and the item tooltip will tell you so.$(br2)Bait disappears about $(bold)10 seconds$() after it enters the water - long enough to scoop it back out if you dropped it by mistake.$(br2)Only after those 10 seconds is the bait eaten and the clock started: 0.5~1 in-game day later, 2-5 fish appear nearby, and they only spawn in natural water.$(br2)This lets you build your own fishing grounds!

pages.title: Winter & Fish
pages.text: With $(bold)Serene Seasons$() installed, bait dropped in winter attracts no fish at all - the water is too cold.$(br2)The good news is that bait is not consumed and the $(bold)10-second countdown never starts$(): it stays in the water, so you can scoop it back out and save it for spring.$(br2)Tropical biomes have no winter (deserts, jungles, warm oceans and the like), so bait works there all year round.$(br2)Bait already dropped before winter is unaffected and still produces fish on its original schedule.$(br2)Don't want winter to stop you? Operators can switch this rule off in the config; it is on by default.

pages.title: Maid Fishing
pages.text: With Touhou Little Maid installed, the maid's fishing task follows exactly the same rules: $(bold)natural water only, and a real fish nearby$(), or there is no bite.$(br2)The difference is that a maid lands the fish herself and collects the drops, while you have to kill the fish pulled to your feet.$(br2)See $(l:animalflee:integration/integration_overview)Mod Integration$().
